meta.title: zicode Developer toolbox
meta.description: The zicode developer toolbox: a sidebar-foot menu that opens a second-level list of your most-used tools (6 by default, adjustable, ordered by usage or manually), plus a full 14-tool panel with an About zicode page and www.zicode.com plus the WeChat official-account QR in the footer. Tools: JSON, encoding, password generator, regex tester, timestamps, color, ASCII, hashes, UUID, text diff, URL parser, text tools, JWT decoder and cron parser. Everything runs locally in the browser; nothing is sent over the network or read from the session.
